stops.note: solid, whole, giving rise to solidare (to make solid)
carried into French for joining metal pieces by fusing them, from solidare
stops.meaning: to join metal pieces by fusing them

stops.note: settled as the English word for joining metal pieces with a fused metal alloy
stops.meaning: to join metal pieces using a fused metal alloy

current_meaning: to join two pieces of metal by melting a metal alloy between them
